title: SEG Evidence Manifest
description: Schema for an EvidenceManifest document in the Safety Evidence Graph. The top-level entry point for an evidence package. Binds Part 1 (DesignConsistencyProof) and Part 2 (ExecutionCoverageRecord) together by IRI reference, alongside the CoverageReport. Anchors the entire package to a specific point in time across all four source repositories via git SHAs. An auditor starts here and follows the IRIs to verify each component independently. Immutable once generated.

id.description: Globally unique IRI for this evidence manifest. Form: {namespaceBase}/proof/{snapshotId}/evidence-manifest. This is the canonical identifier for the complete evidence package.

seg:snapshotId.description: Unique identifier for this proof generation run. Shared across all four component documents in the same proofs/{snapshotId}/ directory. Typically an ISO 8601 timestamp.

seg:scope.description: The set of Requirement node IRIs in scope for this evidence package. Must match the scope declared in the referenced DesignConsistencyProof.

seg:designConsistencyProof.description: IRI reference to the DesignConsistencyProof document for this package. Proves design graph internal consistency for the defined scope. Independently verifiable by recomputing the Merkle root from the node manifest.

seg:executionCoverageRecord.description: IRI reference to the ExecutionCoverageRecord document for this package. Proves that declared tests were executed against a specific implementation state and records their outcomes. Independently verifiable against repo C and repo G.

seg:coverageReport.description: IRI reference to the CoverageReport document for this package. Documents gaps, suspect links, stale outcomes, and overall proof readiness status. Present regardless of whether proof generation succeeded or was refused.

seg:repoASha.description: Full git SHA of repo A (requirements) at proof generation time. 40 hex chars for SHA-1 repos, 64 for SHA-256 repos. Anchors the requirement content to a specific point in time.

seg:repoBSha.description: Full git SHA of repo B (implementations and test specifications) at proof generation time. 40 hex chars for SHA-1 repos, 64 for SHA-256 repos. Must match seg:repoBSha on all TestOutcome nodes in the ExecutionCoverageRecord.

seg:repoCSha.description: Full git SHA of repo C (test outcomes) at proof generation time. 40 hex chars for SHA-1 repos, 64 for SHA-256 repos. Anchors the test runner output to a specific point in time.

seg:repoGSha.description: Full git SHA of repo G (graph state) at proof generation time. 40 hex chars for SHA-1 repos, 64 for SHA-256 repos. Anchors the entire graph — nodes, edges, waivers, review events — to a specific point in time. An auditor can reconstruct the complete graph state by checking out repo G at this SHA.
